Arian Kabashi is a professional footballer born on October 28, 1996, in Pristina, Kosovo. He is known for his skills as a midfielder. Kabashi began his youth career at several clubs, including FC Thun and FC Basel in Switzerland, where he developed his talent.

Kabashi has played for various teams in different leagues, including stints in lower-tier leagues, showcasing his abilities as a versatile midfielder. He has also represented national teams at the youth level for Kosovo, contributing to the development of football in his home country.

Throughout his career, Kabashi has been recognized for his technical skills, tactical awareness, and ability to control the midfield. His playing style combines creativity and tenacity, making him an asset to his teams.
